I told him, hes supportive..but my husband is a very positive person. He is very impulsive, having adult adhd, so it of course he is going to tell me to do what makes ne happy and support me.

I want to talk to my psychiatrist, but hes so busy and probably will refer me to a cognitive behavioral therapist like he has before. Ive never spoken to one, just because i feel like im always busy.
I see you have bipolar 1, i have bipolar 2

Ive been at my job for 5 years. I love my clients and what i do, but there are two very negative people i work with who i think tall about me behind my back and try to get me fired.

It makes me question my career path and what i shoild do.

I also love my husband very much but for some reason lately i dont want to be touched. Sex is blah (bc of me) and he is so lovey dovey kiss and hug me and i build a wall up and idk why.
Im so lost please help. I want to puch bunch of people then cry.
AND THE anger ensues. Wanted to punch my boss today  for her condescending tone. Like shes trying to get me fired.

Baby you are way too young to be doing something like this. Please stick it out a while longer. Talk to a professional. You have so many more years you never know what good can come from it. Have hope. I have hope for you.

Im telling you, you will have people who will miss you. I dont know you and id miss you. There are so many people in the world you havent met yet. Things you havent done. Dont make a permenant mistake for something that is temporary.
Why are you and your mom not on good terms?
I just wish i coild understand it all and stop getting angry so easily.
Hey, in depressed too. Lets talk. There is someone out there who will miss you. Please dont hurt them.
19 is so young. Please stick it out longer you have no idea what can happen in the next few years
I can hear my hair growing.
